title: The Double Extraction
author: Oscar Yarrow
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
